content:
alisha (support): FYI customer ticket #C-4321 — after upgrading our JS SDK to 1.4.2 they're seeing intermittent JSON parse failures in JSON mode. Happening across dev/prod, ~0.8% of requests since 2026-03-16. Link: https://tickets.internal/C-4321 :eyes:

sam (ml-eng): Can you paste the exact SDK call + raw model output they're getting? Also which model variant are they on?

alisha (support): Repro steps from the customer:
1) npm i @redwood/sdk@1.4.2
2) call client.generate({ mode: 'json', schema: mySchema, prompt: '...' })
3) occasionally the SDK throws: `JSONParseError: Invalid JSON: trailing comma at position 254`

They captured the response body in support logs (sanitized):
```
{"invoice_id": "inv_123", "amount": 120.00, "items": [ {"name":"widget","qty":1}, ], "notes":"Delivered on 2026-03-15" }
```
(note the trailing comma after items array)

john (eng-oncall): Thanks. That looks like model produced a trailing comma. Two things I'm worried about:
- Our metrics currently increment `parse_failure` only when SDK returns null/throws — but customer says some responses are being heuristically fixed by the SDK and returned as success, so we aren't counting them as failures.
- Logs are storing full raw model output right now which contains PII in some cases; security flagged this when I looked at example traces.

maya (product): Priority: P2 for now, but if rate climbs >1.5% across customers this becomes P1. Customers with billing/SLAs in enterprise tier need a faster SLA.

sam (ml-eng): Reprobed locally with the same prompt using model-redwood-v1-small. I forced output to include trailing commas by seeding example responses — reproduce rate ~3% over 1k runs. SDK 1.4.2 has a relaxed heuristic that attempts to correct some JSON (we added it to reduce fail noise). That heuristic currently swallows a warning state.

sam (ml-eng): Proposed changes:
- SDK should emit explicit telemetry `json_parse_warning` when heuristics modify output (not just `json_parse_failure`).
- Server-side ingest should still mark the API response as 200 but include header `X-Redwood-Json-Parse: heuristics-applied` when heuristics run.
- Observability: add a Grafana panel for `json_parse_warning` + `json_parse_failure` over time and Alert when (failure + warning)/total_requests > 1% in last 5m.

alisha (support): +1 for the telemetry. Customer wants deterministic behavior though — they prefer a hard fail option so they can fall back to non-JSON mode. Can we expose `strictJson: true` flag in SDK/config so they can opt out of heuristics?

sam (ml-eng): Yes, we can. I'll add `strictJson` default false to avoid breaking existing customers. strictJson=true => SDK will not apply heuristics and will return an error when parse fails. Also emit `json_parse_failure` metric and include parse error message (hashed) in telemetry.

john (eng-oncall): On the ops side I can add a dashboard now; provisional panels: parse_failure_rate, parse_warning_rate, top-5 prompts by parse warnings, and a histogram of token-length vs parse rate. I'll also change logs to redact model outputs by default in the public dashboard: store only `sha256(raw_output)` + length + sanitized preview (first 120 chars with PII redacted). I'll coordinate with redact-bot.

redact-bot: Notice: existing logs contain potential PII. I recommend applying pattern redaction for emails, credit card numbers, and SSNs before storing previews. See runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redaction

maya (product): We should update docs and changelog for SDK 1.4.3 (release with strictJson + telemetry). Also include migration note: customers using earlier heuristic behavior need to opt-in to keep it.

alisha (support): Action items from support perspective:
- Provide customer with repro steps + explain upcoming fix and ETA: release v1.4.3 early next week, will include strictJson and telemetry.
- Offer them a temporary workaround: set `mode: 'chat'` or downgrade SDK to 1.4.1 if they can't accept heuristics.

sam (ml-eng): Dev tasks (assigned to me):
- Add strictJson flag + telemetry (`json_parse_warning`, `json_parse_failure`).
- Include header `X-Redwood-Json-Parse` when heuristics applied or when strictJson causes failure.
- Add unit tests and 10k-run fuzz test to estimate heuristic effect per model.
ETA: Weds EOD.

john (eng-oncall): Ops tasks (assigned to me):
- New Grafana panel and alert as proposed.
- Sanitize log pipeline: only preview + sha256 + length.
ETA: Tue EOD.

maya (product): Docs/tasks (assigned to me):
- Update SDK changelog, add migration guide.
- Customer communication template for support to send.
ETA: Thu noon.

alisha (support): I'll message the customer this afternoon with a temporary workaround and ETA. I'll also attach the sample sanitized output above and ask for any additional examples.

observability-bot: Metric created: `json_parse_warning` (counter) — please ensure SDK emits `metric_id=mp-984`.

sam (ml-eng): One more thing — sampling: we only export parse metrics for 10% of requests to keep cardinality low. Given these subtle failures we should sample 100% for requests with `mode: 'json'` for the next 48 hours while we validate. Ops: can you flip that?

john (eng-oncall): Yep flipping to 100% for JSON mode now. Will revert in 48h or when we say so.

alisha (support): Customer replied — they can provide 3 more raw examples. Asking them to scrub PII and upload to secure share by EOD.

sam (ml-eng): Good — once we have those I'll run them through a crash tester that compares strictJson vs heuristic behavior and output diffs. I'll paste a short summary here when done.

john (eng-oncall): Created dashboard draft: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/json-parse-observability (share pending). Also opened incident-ish ticket INC-9012 to track.

maya (product): OK wrapping — we should have a follow-up sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm SDK patch + dashboards. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

alisha (support): Thanks all — marking this thread as active until SDK release. I’ll update customer after the patch.
